headline: Strangers Unite to Free Great Horned Owl from Barbed Wire
meta_description: A great horned owl trapped on barbed wire was rescued by an unexpected chain of help: a couple, a passing driver, and a property owner working together.
summary_short: When a great horned owl became impaled on barbed wire, a chain of strangers sprang into action—each bringing exactly what was needed to set it free.
body:
A great horned owl impaled on barbed wire has been saved through the swift cooperation of strangers who happened to be in the right place at the right time.

The rescue unfolded as a sequence of timely interventions. A couple discovered the trapped bird and stopped to help. A passing driver, recognizing the emergency, pulled over and provided essential tools—gloves and wire cutters. The property owner, seeing the effort to save the animal, granted permission to cut through the fence itself.

This convergence of willingness and resourcefulness gave the owl a second chance. The combination of quick thinking, material aid, and property access created the conditions for a successful rescue—a reminder that compassion often finds its way when strangers choose to act.
quick_facts: Great horned owl trapped on barbed wire
Couple discovered and stopped to help
Passing driver brought gloves and wire cutters
Property owner granted permission to cut fence
